2609.15660.title: CiteShade: Citation Laundering in Multi-Source Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Its Counterfactual Defense
2609.15660.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model's answers on retrieved external knowledge and returns each answer with citations that identify its sources. Those citations are the user's audit trail: they let a reader verify a claim without trusting the model. Prior security work on RAG asks whether an attacker can corrupt the answer, leaving the citation channel unexplored. We show that this channel is a new and practical attack surface. We propose CiteShade, the first citation laundering attack to RAG, in which an attacker controlling a single source induces a model to produce an attacker-chosen wrong answer and to attribute it to a trusted source that does not support it, while the evidence for the correct answer remains in context. We formulate the attack as an optimization problem, derive three necessary conditions (retrieval, generation, and citation) and construct sources satisfying them without any instruction. On multi-source multi-hop question answering the attack raises the wrong-answer rate from 0.01 to 0.68, and source deletion confirms the malicious source is the causal driver in every measured case. Vulnerability tracks a model's propensity to cite rather than its scale, reaching CLR 0.84 under explicit instruction and 0.64 with no instruction at all on the most citation-prone model tested. We then show that perplexity filtering and citation-support checking are each insufficient, and propose a counterfactual defense that verifies which source actually drove the answer.
2609.15660.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）將語言模型的答案基於檢索的外部知識，並返回每個答案及其來源的引用。這些引用是用戶的審計痕跡：它們讓讀者能夠在不信任模型的情況下驗證一個主張。先前對RAG的安全性研究探討了攻擊者是否能夠破壞答案，但未探索引用通道。我們顯示這個通道是一個新的且實際的攻擊面。我們提出CiteShade，首個針對RAG的引用洗錢攻擊，其中控制單一來源的攻擊者誘導模型產生一個攻擊者選擇的錯誤答案，並將其歸因於一個不支持該答案的可信來源，而正確答案的證據仍然在上下文中。我們將這個攻擊形式化為一個優化問題，推導出三個必要條件（檢索、生成和引用），並構建滿足這些條件的來源，無需任何指示。在多來源多跳問題回答中，該攻擊將錯誤答案率從0.01提高到0.68，並且來源刪除確認在每個測量案例中惡意來源是因果驅動因素。脆弱性跟蹤模型引用的傾向而非其規模，在明確指示下達到CLR 0.84，並在完全沒有指示的情況下在測試的最引用傾向模型上達到0.64。我們接著顯示困惑度過濾和引用支持檢查各自都不夠充分，並提出一種反事實防禦，驗證實際上是哪些來源驅動了答案。
